segments.text: IN the second petition, we desired that God would let his kingdome come, vz. That he would rule in our hearts. If he then must raigne, we must be his subiects: and therefore here we craue, that beeing his subiects wee may obey him, and doe his will. Mal. 1.6. If I be a father where is my honour? If I be a master, where is my feare?
